data.content_ref: inline:The entire neighbourhood ABSTRACTS a single covering principle — that cost is a monotone increasing function of quantity with f(7) = $2 — from which each artifact is a special case: SRC_002 fixes f to be linear, SRC_001 leverages integer homogeneity, SRC_004 explores a concave f, SRC_003 denies that f is uniquely determined. The abstraction is the function class to which f belongs. Refuted if two artifacts' mechanisms cannot be expressed as restrictions of a single monotone f with f(7)=$2 — e.g., if one artifact requires f to be non-monotone or discontinuous at 7, which would place it outside the abstracted function class and break the unification.
